'''Alasdair Iain Houston''' is an English evolutionary biologist and ecologist known for his work in [[behavioural ecology]]. He is Emeritus Professor in the School of Biological Sciences at the [[University of Bristol]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.bristol.ac.uk/biology/people/alasdair-i-houston/overview.html |title=Professor Alasdair Houston  |website=School of Biological Sciences |publisher=[[University of Bristol]] |language=en-GB |access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref> He was elected a fellow of the [[Royal Society]] in 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/alasdair-houston-11651/ |title=Alasdair Houston  |website=[[Royal Society]] |language=en-gb |access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ams.org/home/page/ |title=Mathematical Scientists Elected Royal Society Fellows   |date=2012-04-24 |website=[[American Mathematical Society]] |language=en |access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref>
